::: {#exm-cubic-big-omega}
#### $2 n^3 + 40 = \Omega(n^3)$

For every natural number $n \ge 1$,

$$
\ba
\abs{2 n^3 + 40}
&= 2 n^3 + 40
&& \text{(} 2 n^3 + 40 > 0 \text{)}
\\&\ge 2 n^3
&& \text{(} 40 \ge 0 \text{)}
\\&= 2 \abs{n^3},
\ea
$$

so $c = 2$ and $N = 1$ are witnesses (@def-witness) for $2 n^3 + 40 = \Omega(n^3)$ (@def-big-omega).

:::
